Are you passionate about creating robust and scalable software solutions?
Join us as a Full Stack Developer and play a key role in building impactful applications. We’re looking for someone with a strong technical background, problem-solving mindset, and collaborative attitude to help shape our innovative projects.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and implement scalable software applications using C# and .NET Core.
Build and optimize Web APIs with a focus on best practices.
Work with JavaScript, jQuery, and other front-end technologies to deliver seamless user experiences.
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code with a focus on performance and scalability.
Collaborate with developers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver new features and enhancements.
Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade the software to ensure optimal functionality.
Lead by example, providing technical guidance and mentorship to the team.
Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Experience: 2 years of hands-on experience in software development, including front-end and back-end work.
Technical Skills:
Strong expertise in C#, .NET Core, MVC, and Microservices architecture.
Proficiency in JavaScript, jQuery, and other front-end frameworks.
Knowledge of database management and integration.
Soft Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities.

Why Join Us?
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

About Us
Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.
Higharc is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the technical architecture and delivery of our Home Design Experience application, a browser-based 3D tool that lets anyone design a home. You’ll report to the VP of Engineering and serve as the primary technical partner to the team’s product/UX lead.
As the HDE team’s most experienced engineer, you’ll make consequential technical decisions, write production code, and help other engineers deliver. Your immediate focus will be getting the application into customers’ hands. Along the way, you’ll partner with our platform team to establish shared foundations and patterns that other Higharc applications can reuse.
What You'll Do
You’ll need to move fast, make good calls under ambiguity, and turn rough product ideas into working software that customers can pick up and use without a manual. You'll work across the primary UI as well as AI-supported and agentic experiences, and you'll partner with the other staff-level engineers at Higharc to give the company's technical strategy real shape.
Expect to:
Rapidly prototype new home design workflows and turn the ones that land into customer-ready software
Lead development of interactive 3D home design workflows, connecting the application UI, design data, and real-time 3D scene into a responsive experience. Build AI-supported and agentic interactions that help users design their homes.
Own application architecture and technical delivery from early prototypes through production. Make decisions across the frontend, application state, and service integration, including performance, reliability, and testing.
Be an independent technical partner to the product/UX lead: challenge assumptions, identify risks early, propose alternatives, and help decide what to build next.
Turn ambiguous goals into concrete implementation plans, resolve technical unknowns through working code, and implement the critical pieces yourself to keep delivery moving.
Partner with the platform team to use and improve shared application foundations. Identify which patterns should be reused across Higharc and help implement and document them, keeping immediate product delivery central to those decisions.
Help less experienced engineers take ownership through pairing, code review, and clear technical guidance. Establish patterns they can confidently extend.
About You
You've shipped products that solve genuinely hard problems in a way that feels effortless to the end user, and you know how much unglamorous work sits behind that kind of simplicity. You're comfortable being the most senior engineer in the room without needing everything decided before you start building, and you know how to narrow scope, ship useful increments, and make technical decisions that support continued delivery.
You have:
A track record of personally architecting, building, and shipping substantial web applications, with responsibility for technical decisions from initial implementation through production use.
Deep hands-on experience with TypeScript, React, and modern web application architecture, including application state, API integration, performance, and maintainability.
A strong plus: hands-on experience with Three.js and browser-based 3D applications, especially design or CAD tools. You’ll be helping people design homes in 3D, so experience making complex spatial interactions intuitive is particularly valuable.
Genuine enthusiasm for AI-forward development and for building AI-supported or agentic product experiences
Experience making technical decisions independently in partnership with a product or design lead. You can explain tradeoffs, challenge a proposed approach constructively, and commit to a path forward.
Sound judgment about what to build for the immediate product and what to generalize for reuse, with experience collaborating across application and platform teams.
Experience helping less experienced engineers deliver through implementation, mentoring, and technical guidance.
A growth mindset and real ease with ambiguity, on a team and product area that's still being defined
Strong instincts for design and craft, even though you're not the designer on the team
Working at Higharc
Remote work and travel: Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process.
Compensation and benefits: Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. We also provide a stipend to create the ideal home office and support ongoing L&D.
Please note: we are seeing an uptick of fraudulent recruiting activity claiming to be associated with Higharc. All communication and outreach from our in-house team will come from an @higharc.com email address.

As an hourly paid, fully remote Rust Engineer for AI Data Training, you will review AI-generated Rust code and explanations or generate your own, evaluate the reasoning quality and step-by-step problem-solving, and provide expert feedback that helps models produce answers that are accurate, logical, and clearly explained. You will assess solutions for correctness, safety, and adherence to the prompt; identify errors in ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, or algorithmic reasoning; fact-check information; write high-quality explanations and model solutions that demonstrate idiomatic Rust patterns; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on correctness and reasoning quality. This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate that provides AI training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation model labs. Your work will directly help improve the world’s premier AI models while giving you the flexibility of impactful, detail-oriented remote contract work.
Important
There is no immediate project for this role; however, if qualified, you will be among the first experts we reach out to when relevant opportunities arise. This will also provide you with access to future projects available through our expert network.
Key Responsibilities
Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts in various topics and responses to guide AI learning, ensuring the models reflect a comprehensive understanding of diverse subjects.
Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI responses to enhance the model's accuracy, fluency, and contextual relevance.
Ensure Model Integrity: Test AI models for potential inaccuracies or biases, validating their reliability across use cases.
Your Profile
1–2+ years of professional Rust development experience in backend, CLI, or systems-focused projects.
Strong understanding of Rust’s ownership, borrowing, and lifetime model, with the ability to reason clearly about aliasing and data races.
Solid software engineering experience in at least one of backend services, command-line tools, or systems programming using Rust.
Ability to evaluate safe, idiomatic Rust code, including appropriate use of traits, generics, pattern matching, and error handling.
Significant experience using LLMs or AI coding assistants while programming, combined with a disciplined approach to validating their output.
Excellent English writing skills, capable of producing precise, structured, and pedagogical technical explanations.
Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related technical field.
Previous experience with AI data training, code review at scale, or evaluation of AI-generated technical content is strongly preferred; Minimum C1 English proficiency and an extremely detail-oriented working style are required.
Highly preferred: experience with Tokio, Actix, Serde, and async Rust patterns in production or advanced side projects.
Preferred: competitive programming experience, contributions to Rust open-source ecosystems, and demonstrated ability to reason about performance, concurrency, and correctness in Rust code.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
Marketing & Privacy Engineering (MPE) builds trusted, privacy-aware consumer web experiences and measurement systems that enable sustainable growth. Within MPE, the MarTech pillar owns Affirm’s Logged-Out Web experiences, web experimentation, client-side tagging, marketing technology integrations, attribution, and measurement. As a Software Engineer II on MPE, you will build and improve high-traffic consumer web experiences while contributing to the experimentation, instrumentation, and marketing integrations that help Affirm understand and grow consumer acquisition. You will work in a modern web stack across React, TypeScript, shared component systems, testing, performance, and observability, with opportunities to develop deeper expertise in technologies such as Google Tag Manager, analytics and experimentation platforms, conversion tracking, and marketing APIs. You will partner with senior engineers as well as Product, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and Data Engineering to ship reliable experiences and ensure measurement and privacy requirements are considered during development. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys building polished web products, learning new technical domains, and taking increasing ownership of systems that operate at scale.
What You'll Do
With the support of your team’s tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.
You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.
What We Look For
You have a total of 1.5+ years of experience as a software engineer.
You have experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue.
You have experience working with Javascript/Typescript.
You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field
Base Pay Grade - L
Equity Grade - 6
Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

Remote-first with flexibility built in

All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Our goal is to automate entire workflows — from finding candidates and identifying opportunities to matching jobs, communicating with clients, managing recruitment pipelines and analysing performance.
We're looking for a talented Full Stack Developer who loves building things, solving problems and using AI to work faster and smarter.
You'll join a small, ambitious engineering team, working closely with our Head of Engineering to turn ideas into working products.
This isn't a role where you'll spend your days fixing tickets or making minor changes to somebody else's software.
You'll be building real systems, solving real business problems and seeing your work used every day.

AI Agents: Building intelligent agents using Claude, OpenAI and other AI tools to automate complex business processes.
Full Stack Applications: Developing internal platforms, dashboards and applications using React, Next.js, Python and FastAPI.

Strong experience with Python and JavaScript/TypeScript.

Experience developing APIs and backend services, ideally using FastAPI.
Good understanding of databases, SQL and data structures.
Experience integrating third-party APIs.
Experience building automations using n8n, Python or similar tools.
Confident using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot.
Ability to independently solve problems and deliver working software.
Nice to have:
Supabase or Firebase.
Render, Railway or similar deployment platforms.
AI agents, MCP, LLM APIs or agent orchestration.
Salesforce integrations.
Experience building data pipelines or large-scale automation systems.
You don't need to know every technology listed. We're much more interested in someone who can learn quickly, solve problems and build great software.
The type of person who will thrive here
We're looking for a genuine builder.
Someone who enjoys taking a problem, understanding what needs to happen and figuring out the best way to make it work.
You'll probably enjoy this role if you:
Love coding and building new products.
Already use AI tools to make yourself a more productive developer.
Enjoy learning new technologies and experimenting with new ideas.
Take ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
Can work across frontend, backend, databases and automation.
Care about delivering working solutions, not just writing code.
Communicate clearly and enjoy being part of a collaborative team.
We value intelligence, curiosity, speed of learning and execution more than impressive CVs or academic qualifications.
Why join We Are Revolution?
Build with AI every day. You'll work with modern AI tools, automation platforms and emerging technologies on genuine commercial applications.
Work on meaningful projects. Your software won't sit unused. You'll see the impact of what you build across a growing international business.
Real responsibility and ownership. You'll be trusted to contribute ideas, make technical decisions and own projects.
Work alongside experienced leadership. You'll collaborate directly with our Head of Engineering and company leadership, who are committed to investing in technology.
Opportunity to grow. We're building an increasingly sophisticated technology platform, creating opportunities to develop your skills and responsibilities as the team grows.
Remote working. Work from India or Pakistan as part of an international team.
Competitive compensation. We're looking for capability, not simply the cheapest developer. We'll consider stronger packages for exceptional candidates.
How to apply
We'd love to hear from you if you're a developer who genuinely enjoys building things and wants to work at the intersection of AI, software engineering and business automation .
Please send us your CV, GitHub or portfolio, and tell us briefly:
What's the most interesting application, AI agent or automation you've personally built, and what did it achieve?
We care much more about what you've actually built than how many technologies you can list on your CV.
Come and help us build the future of AI-powered recruitment.
